scope: dev-only read path: natural-language query -> BGE-M3 dense and sparse query vectors -> existing Qdrant collection -> ranked SearchResult list; no answer generation

query_embedding.rule: the query is encoded by the same indexing.embedder.BgeM3Embedder (document-indexing contract embedding section, same artifacts and embedding_key); no separate query model, tokenizer or instruction prefix
query_embedding.vectors: one dense and one sparse vector per query from BgeM3Embedder.encode

collection.rule: collection = indexing.qdrant_store.collection_name(indexing contract, embedder.identity.embedding_key); never configured or hard-coded
collection.missing: a missing collection fails (retrieval_collection_missing); the retriever never creates a collection
collection.schema: the existing collection must pass indexing.qdrant_store.schema_differences for the current identity before any search; a mismatch fails

read_only: retrieval calls only Qdrant read APIs (collection_exists, get_collection, query_points); it never parses, chunks, embeds documents, upserts, deletes or cleans stale points

modes.dense: query_points on vector 'dense' (Cosine) with the dense query vector
modes.sparse: query_points on sparse vector 'sparse' (dot product) with the sparse query vector
modes.hybrid: dense and sparse candidate lists fused client-side by Reciprocal Rank Fusion

fusion.score: sum over modes of 1 / (rrf_k + rank) with 1-based rank; a mode that did not return the point contributes 0
fusion.tie_break: higher RRF score, then smaller best rank over modes, then chunk_id ascending
fusion.not_used: raw score sum, weighted sum, DBSF, learned fusion and rerankers

options.top_k_status: dev convenience value, not an evaluated production setting
options.filters: optional exact match on payload keyword indexes pblanc_id and source_sha256 only; no MySQL lookup or eligibility filtering

result.source: all document fields come from the stored point payload (FinalChunk.payload()); no other metadata store
result.score: dense: cosine score, sparse: dot score, hybrid: RRF score; raw scores of different modes are not comparable
